subject.title: Subagent lifecycle observability + async supervision controls

question: Should OpenClaw promote the current task, audit, and subagent summaries into a durable ordered subagent lifecycle and audited supervision contract now, and which persistence/API owner should be canonical?
rationale: Source inspection shows several viable foundations, but choosing persistence ownership, public API shape, authorization scopes, retention, redaction, and audit semantics requires maintainer product and security intent.

options.title: Design shared audit-backed contract
options.body: Use the metadata-audit/task foundation as the canonical durable source, then add subagent-specific lifecycle receipt and supervision views over it.

options.title: Add subagent-specific ledger
options.body: Create a dedicated subagent lifecycle and supervision table/API now, accepting a narrower but parallel audit source of truth.

options.title: Keep summaries only
options.body: Decline durable lifecycle receipts for now and continue using task/subagent summaries plus internal control helpers.

recommendation.title: Design shared audit-backed contract
recommendation.body: Use the metadata-audit/task foundation as the canonical durable source, then add subagent-specific lifecycle receipt and supervision views over it.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history across subagent registry/control and adjacent task seams, and the decision is primarily about that owner boundary.
